question: If you could instantly absorb all the skills and knowledge of a master in any creative field, which one would you pick and why?
If your current creative project suddenly had to be adapted into a completely ridiculous video game genre, what would it look like?
If one of your fictional characters suddenly had to narrate your entire day today using dramatic voiceover, what would they complain about first?
If your creative workspace suddenly gained the ability to talk, what annoying habit or weird quirk of yours would it roast you for first?
If your creative process had a bizarre loading screen tip that appeared every time you sat down to work, what would it say?
If your creative style or current project had a signature snack that fueled every single decision, what weird combination of foods would it be?
If your current creative project had to be soundtracked entirely by poorly played kazoo covers, which scene would become an instant masterpiece?
If your current creative WIP had to be explained entirely through dramatic interpretive dance by your favorite video game character, how would the plot look?
If your creative brain was a messy little room in a weird hotel, what kind of bizarre decor or chaotic roommate would anyone find inside?
If you had to assign a dramatic, cinematic theme song to play every single time you finally hit save on a project, what does it sound like?
